outperformer.headline: Capital-efficient manufacturer with exceptional returns and strong cash generation
outperformer.reason: Netweb delivers a 37.5% ROCE versus the 14.5% peer median and a 32.8% ROE against 15.26%, driven by an asset-light manufacturing model (only 1% manufacturing cost as % of revenue vs 5.2% median) that minimizes fixed asset intensity while capturing high-margin system integration and AI/HPC server assembly. The company generated ₹779 crore positive FCF versus a peer median of -₹43 crore, reflecting superior working capital management despite higher inventory days (170 vs 42), as it operates a build-to-order model for customized data center infrastructure. The grounded notes confirm a sustainable business model backed by compliance advantages and rising net margins (projected 11.4%, already at 9.4% vs 3.55% median), positioning it as India's compute backbone provider in the AI-cloud era.
outperformer.india_vs_global: Indian data center players like Netweb focus on system integration and localized manufacturing with lower capex intensity, while global peers (AMD, Broadcom, Micron) are semiconductor/chip designers with vastly higher R&D and fabrication costs but no comparable financials provided for direct comparison.

picks.name: Netweb Technologies India Ltd
picks.thesis: RevCAGR3Y 69.9%, ProfitCAGR3Y 63.7%, ROCE 37.5%, ROE 32.8%, D/E 0.39, promoter 66.98%. Order book ₹25,069mn (Jun'26) with strategic orders ₹21,840mn announced Sept'25. AI systems drove 172% revenue growth, positioned for India's ₹1.9L Cr data center opportunity by 2030.
picks.risk: High PE 103x and execution risk on mega-deal order book conversion.

picks.name: Cummins India Ltd
picks.thesis: RevCAGR3Y 16%, ProfitCAGR3Y 24.4%, ROCE 39.5%, ROE 30.2%, D/E 0, promoter 51%. Zero debt, strong cash generation (CFO/OP 66.8%). Order book extends through 2028 with capacity expansion underway, critical backup power provider for data centers.
picks.risk: Diesel genset demand may face long-term headwinds from renewable energy adoption.

picks.name: Polycab India Ltd
picks.thesis: RevCAGR3Y 27%, ProfitCAGR3Y 28.3%, ROCE 33.2%, ROE 23%, D/E 0.02, promoter 61.46%. Clean balance sheet, rising margins. India data center capacity expanding 1.6GW to 8-15GW creates strong cable demand. Exports targeting 10%+ of revenue by 2030.
picks.risk: Commodity price volatility and competitive intensity in cables segment.

picks.name: Hitachi Energy India Ltd
picks.thesis: RevCAGR3Y 22.2%, ProfitCAGR3Y 119%, ROCE 29.4%, ROE 21.9%, D/E 0.02, promoter 71.31%. Robust order inflows, 62% profit jump Q1FY27. Integrated sustainable designs for data center power distribution, strong execution momentum.
picks.risk: Very high PE 117x limits margin of safety despite strong fundamentals.

picks.name: Infosys Ltd
picks.thesis: ROCE 40%, ROE 31.9%, D/E 0.1, promoter 13.82%, DII 42.78%. Despite modest RevCAGR3Y 6.8%, delivers exceptional returns with 80.4% CFO/OP. Autonomous AI data center vision for 2030, strong institutional backing, attractive PE 13.5x.
picks.risk: Slow revenue growth 6.8% and falling margins indicate competitive pressure.

picks.name: V-Marc India Ltd
picks.thesis: RevCAGR3Y 93.6%, ProfitCAGR3Y 115.4%, ROCE 41.4%, ROE 41.4%, promoter 64.87%. Exceptional growth, expanding capacity to ~7L km over 4-5 years. Data center cable demand rising with 19-22% annual capacity growth globally through 2030.
picks.risk: High D/E 0.74 and low interest coverage 4.4x raise financial risk.

picks.name: ABB India Ltd
picks.thesis: RevCAGR3Y 15.5%, ProfitCAGR3Y 18%, ROCE 29.9%, ROE 22.4%, D/E 0.02, promoter 75%. Strong order momentum +25% Q1'26, USD 75mn expansion investment announced. Order backlog crossed ₹10,000 Cr. 50% orders from renewables/data centers.
picks.risk: Very high PE 94.9x creates valuation risk despite strong fundamentals.

picks.name: TechD Cybersecurity Ltd
picks.thesis: RevCAGR3Y 86.6%, ProfitCAGR3Y 141%, ROCE 40.9%, ROE 29.9%, D/E 0, promoter 63.24%. Zero debt, exceptional growth, 36% EBITDA margin. Global data center capacity reaching 200GW by 2030 drives cybersecurity demand. Attractive PE 28.3x.
picks.risk: Small scale (₹52 Cr revenue) and ROCE falling despite growth.

picks.name: ESDS Software Solution Ltd
picks.thesis: RevCAGR3Y 31.4%, EBITDAm 50%, PATm 25.6%, ROCE 30.2%, ROE 24.9%, D/E 0.18. Exceptional 50% EBITDA margin, CFO/OP 584.6%. SEBI-approved ₹600-720 Cr IPO for capacity expansion. India data center capacity 1.3GW to 5GW by 2030.

picks.name: Persistent Systems Ltd
picks.thesis: RevCAGR3Y 20.9%, ProfitCAGR3Y 26.5%, ROCE 34.4%, ROE 27.2%, D/E 0.06, DII 30.25%. Q1 profit +39% YoY to ₹424.93 Cr, FY26 revenue $1,654.4mn (+17.4%). MediaAgility acquisition strengthens cloud capabilities. Order booking $520.8mn TCV Q1.

picks.name: Siemens Ltd
picks.thesis: RevCAGR3Y 15.5%, ProfitCAGR3Y 21.3%, ROCE 21.4%, ROE 19.2%, D/E 0.02, promoter 75%. Record orders driven by US data center demand, Iran war. DCIM software and electrical infrastructure provider. Strong balance sheet, rising margins.

picks.name: E2E Networks Ltd
picks.thesis: RevCAGR3Y 55%, EBITDAm 51%, promoter 39.45%. Swung to ₹43.9 Cr profit Q1FY27 from ₹2.8 Cr loss, revenue 3.3X YoY. Added 2,048 H200 GPUs, total ~3,700, targeting 10,000+ GPUs. Board approved ₹1,500 Cr raise for capacity expansion.
key_metrics: Q1 FY27: profit ₹43.9 Cr vs loss
picks.risk: Negative ROCE -0.51%, ROE -0.95% and extreme PE 427x despite recent profitability.

picks.name: Eco Recycling Ltd
picks.thesis: RevCAGR3Y 38.7%, ProfitCAGR3Y 56.5%, ROCE 30.8%, ROE 23.6%, D/E 0.04, promoter 73.35%. Exceptional 60% EBITDA margin, 47.9% PAT margin. US data center capacity 118GW by 2030 (+52% revision) drives e-waste opportunity. PE 31.2x reasonable.
picks.risk: Very small scale (₹48 Cr revenue) and low CFO/OP 44.8% raise scalability concerns.

ranking.reason: Dominant across profitability, growth, and cash generation metrics. Asset-light manufacturing model (1% manufacturing cost) delivers exceptional capital efficiency. Strong FCF despite inventory build reflects build-to-order discipline. Only weakness is elevated inventory days (170 vs 42) and high valuation (103 PE vs 76 median), but justified by 91.5% profit CAGR over 5 years.

Strong return ratios and excellent working capital management (negative CCC means suppliers finance operations). Largest revenue base (₹6,322 cr) provides scale, but growth has stalled (5.9% 1Y, 0.2% 3Y CAGR vs 35%+ peer median). Higher debt (0.9 D/E vs 0.3 median) and weak interest coverage (3.5x vs 7.6x) constrain score. Integrated model with 28.48% manufacturing cost suggests heavier asset base than Netweb.

Cloud infrastructure player with exceptional gross margins (73.2% vs 57.4%) by offering India-based alternatives at 20-25% the cost of global hyperscalers, per grounded notes. However, currently loss-making (PAT -6.5%, negative ROE/ROCE) due to massive capex phase (CWIP ₹533 cr, FCF -₹1,140 cr). High valuation (427 PE) prices in future profitability. Strong operating leverage potential once infrastructure monetizes, but execution risk remains.

Services-focused integrated player with flexible engagement models (on-premise, offshore, hybrid per notes), but fundamentally weak across most metrics. ROCE 7.39% and ROE 4.82% are half the peer median, reflecting poor capital productivity. Revenue growth anemic (13.6% 3Y CAGR vs 34.3% median). Negative operating cash flow (-₹79 cr, -141% of operating profit) signals working capital stress despite 121-day WC cycle. High employee costs (30.47% vs 13.6% median) compress margins. Cheap valuation reflects weak fundamentals, not opportunity.

report.title: Data Center Segment: Peer Benchmarking
report.summary: Netweb Technologies India leads the Indian data center segment with exceptional capital efficiency and profitability. Its asset-light, build-to-order model for AI/HPC servers delivers 37.5% ROCE (2.6× peer median) and ₹779 crore positive free cash flow versus peer median of -₹43 crore. With net margins approaching 11.4% versus 3.55% median, Netweb is positioned as India's compute infrastructure backbone in the AI-cloud era.

blocks.title: Netweb Technologies: The Standout Performer
blocks.text: Netweb delivers 37.5% return on capital versus 14.5% peer median and 32.8% return on equity versus 15.26% median. Its secret: an ultra-lean manufacturing model (only 1% of revenue spent on manufacturing versus 5.2% median) that focuses on high-margin system integration and custom AI/HPC server assembly. Despite holding more inventory (170 days versus 42), the company generated ₹779 crore positive free cash flow—a stark contrast to the peer median of -₹43 crore.

blocks.title: Asset-Light Advantage
blocks.text: Netweb spends just 1% of revenue on manufacturing versus 5.2% peer median. This build-to-order model for customized data center infrastructure minimizes fixed assets while capturing high margins on system integration and AI/HPC server assembly. The company sources components (79% raw material cost) and focuses on value-added assembly and configuration.

blocks.title: Superior Working Capital Management
blocks.text: Despite holding 170 days of inventory (versus 42 median) for its build-to-order model, Netweb converts operations to cash efficiently. The company generated ₹790 crore from operations and ₹779 crore in free cash flow, demonstrating that its inventory is strategic—tied to confirmed customer orders for customized AI/HPC infrastructure—rather than speculative stock.
